ns2:course.label: History and Foundations of Library and Information Science
ns2:course.description: This required course for all first-semester library and information science (LIS) doctoral students introduces students to the historical foundations of LIS. Examinations of the interactions of socio-cultural, technological and professional factors underlying the emergence of LIS provide a basis for exploring more recent developments in theory and practice. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: LIS doctoral student in their first semester.
